free_tier.stated: available on the Free plan: AI Gateway usage draws on the plan's credit pool, a 300 credit limit on Free, at 180 credits per USD 1 of model usage
free_tier.notes: derived: 300 credits / 180 credits per USD = USD 1.67 of model usage a month, shared with deploys, compute and bandwidth, which draw on the same credits. Derived: 90 credits per minute / 180 credits per USD = USD 0.50 of model usage a minute

endpoint: the base URL Netlify injects as NETLIFY_AI_GATEWAY_URL
interface_detail: provider-native REST for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini and OpenRouter through base URLs and keys that Netlify injects as environment variables in Netlify Functions, Edge Functions and the Netlify CLI dev server
tooling: the official OpenAI, Anthropic, Google GenAI and OpenRouter SDKs read the injected variables; NETLIFY_AI_GATEWAY_KEY and NETLIFY_AI_GATEWAY_URL are always injected
chaining: pairs with the Netlify Free plan recorded at compute/netlify, whose 300 credits it shares; a deployed Function can expose the gateway to a script

limits.value: a 300 credit limit on the Free plan, shared with every other usage meter; USD 1 of model usage is 180 credits
90 credits per minute for the team across all projects on the Free plan (Personal 450, Pro 1,800)
the site must have had at least one production deploy before the gateway activates
the input prompt context window is limited to 200k tokens

binding_note: 300 credits a month are USD 1.67 of model usage and are spent by deploys and bandwidth as well, so the monthly pool binds before the per-minute limit

identity_cost.detail: a Netlify account on the Free plan, which is '$0 forever'; card and phone at signup are unverified on the pages read here

reliability_note: the gateway activates only after a production deploy, and the injected key exists inside Netlify runtimes rather than as a key created by hand
confidence_note: the credit pool, conversion rate and per-minute limit are quoted from the vendor pages; no call was made because the gateway needs a deployed site
